Title: Some users may be unable to access the group feed with Microsoft Viva Engage

User impact: Users may be unable to access the group feed with Viva Engage.

Current status: Our review of service-side telemetry pinpoints that a subset of service infrastructure facilitating access to the Viva Engage group feed has fallen below our manageable service performance thresholds. To better understand this issue, we’re continuing to review our service telemetry to better understand this issue and determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: This issue is preventing any user from accessing the group feed with Microsoft Engage.
